{"user_message": "is this legit?", "emails": [{"from": "billing@healthsoftsolutions.example.com", "subject": "Subscription Renewal Confirmation - Invoice #INV-2025-0874", "body": "Hello,

Your subscription to PatientFlow Analytics has been renewed for the period 2025-09-01 through 2026-08-31. The charge of $12,450.00 was processed to the corporate card ending in 1234. Please find the official receipt attached for your records. No further action is required from you at this time.

Thank you,
HealthSoft Solutions Billing Department"}]}

benign
The message confirms a transaction that already completed and asks for nothing: no link, no credential prompt, no payment redirect. The sender domain matches the vendor named in the body, and the contact details point back to that same domain.
